text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, after an outing—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, she snapped a photo
of a blue road sign.
Just an ordinary, unremarkable sign.
choice_data_list: Hey, why did you take a picture just now?
Hey, why did you take a photo just now?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Wellâ
Because it was such a fine shade of blue.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I'm on a roll today. Think I'll check out some other spots.
Care to come along?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh, found it, found it.
That really is a nice shade of blue for a bus.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was a bus in her line of sight.
However, it had a shape I had never seen before.
choice_data_list: Hey, what on earth is that bus?
Hey, what in the world is that bus?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"That's an amphibious bus they used to use back in the day.
It'd pick up passengers around here and drive all the way out to Lake Sagami."
choice_data_list: From around here?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's for sightseeing for the people who came to watch the races.
I heard it was especially popular with overseas tourists because it gave them a real feel for Japan's nature.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Even after she stopped running, she still draws a crowd like that.
Quite impressive.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking closely, she was surrounded by tourists
not just from Japan, but from overseas, all taking photos of her.
choice_data_list: I see, you're really loved, huh.
I see, you're really loved, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
It really is... a wonderful view.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After she told me to wait on the bench, a few minutes passed—

text_block_list.name: Bluebird
text_block_list.text: Chirp, chirp chirp.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following her gaze—
there sat a bird of brilliant blue.
choice_data_list: Wow, what a beautifully colored girl.
Wow, what a beautifully colored girl!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's a male Red-flanked Bluetail.
I've been seeing it around quite a bit lately.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The blue bird suddenly came to perch atop her head.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —Oh.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Aha, ahaha!
Stop that, it tickles!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, that cracked me up.
Whenever I see him, he always pokes my head, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Before I knew it, the blue bird was nowhere to be seen.
It must have flown away somewhere."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Truly a free spirit.
Popping up out of nowhere, and vanishing before you know it."
choice_data_list: It kind of resembles you.
Kinda reminds me of you, huh.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hm, you think so?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The last place she took me to was a beach that she called her secret spot.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Inhaaaale... Exhaaale...! 
Ah, what a gorgeous blue, as always!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer! Looking at this sea
and sky, what comes to your mind?"
choice_data_list: Hmm, I suppose so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking out at the surface of the sea, I reflected on my day.
I couldn't even keep track of the city buses, let alone Stay Gold—I still had so much to learn.
choice_data_list: The world is sooo vast!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Heh. That's what makes it fun, right?
choice_data_list: Is it fun?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Beyond this blue, there's a mountain
of things I don't know. Even the culture is different. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: This blueness remains unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I close my eyes. And then—
the sound of the wind and waves feels closer than usual.
choice_data_list: Someday, I want to see that blue over there with you.
Someday, I want to see that blue sky beyond with you.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hmm. ...In that case—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
This marks the start of our world tour.
How about this for our very first commemorative photo?
choice_data_list: Huh! Travel around the world?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
You want to go, don't you? To see the world's blue.
Then why not just go?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I've already taken the first photo.
Where should I take the next one?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The trip won't begin until the races settle down.
Even so, her photo album already holds
the very first promised picture.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to traveling around the world with you.
I'm looking forward to traveling around the world with you.
Since we're here, I'd love to take a picture of you too.
Since we're here, I'd love to take a photo of you too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The trip won't begin until the races settle down.
Even so, her photo album already holds
the very first promised picture.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to traveling around the world with you.
I'm looking forward to traveling around the world with you.
Since we're here, I'd love to take a picture of you too.
Since we're here, I'd love to take a photo of you too.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Where should we start?
Should we head east, or maybe west?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Either way,
we need to start finalizing the schedule step by step.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hm, that's rather sudden.
What do you intend to do with a photo of me?
choice_data_list: I want to take my first photo here too.
I want to take the very first photo here too.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I see. Got it.
I'm ready whenever you are.
choice_data_list: In that case... say cheese!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh, got the shot?
...Make sure you don't forget our promise today.
